title: 第21章 切磋第22章 冤家路窄
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
黄昏，天边的夕阳如鲜血一般。
苍云门演武场。
今天林潜刚从炼药堂回到房间，就被许阳给死缠烂打的拉到了演武场。
林潜一脸无奈的跟在许阳的身后，一副无精打采的样子。
倒是许阳，兴致勃勃，不断的给他讲他遇到一个特别好的师兄，指点他通臂拳，他通臂拳有了很大进步。
今天带林潜来演武场，是打算请这位师兄也指点林潜一下通臂拳。
许阳一脸笑意，抱着林潜肩膀，大有一副有福同享的感觉。
林潜得知许阳的用意后，有些哭笑不得，但也不好拒绝许阳的好意。
他有金手指，通臂拳现在的熟练程度不敢说是门内第一，至少前十还是能占一席之地的。
但许阳都约好了，现在拒绝，只会让许阳在别人面前难堪。
“到时候，演一下吧。”
林潜暗暗的想道。
他可不想让别人知道他通臂拳修炼的进度。
此时正是晚餐时间，演武场上并没有多少人。
而在演武场台边上，正站着一个身穿黑衣的壮汉，正是唐杰。
“许师弟，这就是你的朋友吗？”
唐杰看着许阳身边的林潜问道。
“唐师兄，这就是我的朋友，也是我大哥，林潜。”
许阳高兴的介绍道。
“唐师兄。”

林潜问好道。
唐杰开门见山的问道；“林师弟，需要我指导你通臂拳吗？”
“不着急，要不你先指导许阳，我先看看。”
林潜露出微笑道。
“也好，许师弟我们来台上练练？”
唐杰转头朝着许阳说道。
听到唐杰声音，许阳直接用行动回应，已经跳上了高台，一副跃跃欲试。
接着唐杰也跃上台，两人使用通臂拳对打。
唐杰通臂拳力大势沉，但是不够灵活多变，而许阳的通臂拳只能说有板有眼。
林潜看着两人过招，要不是唐杰留手，许阳怕是用不了多久就落败了。
并且林潜注意到，唐杰时不时用余光看着他，这倒是让他有些奇怪。
很快两人对练完毕，许阳喘着粗气，额头流着汗，而唐杰倒显得气定神闲。
对练过程中，唐杰是处处留手，留力，主要是担心自己表现的太过生猛，吓到林潜不敢上来。
content_en:
At dusk, the setting sun on the horizon is like blood.
Cangyunmen martial arts arena.
Today, as soon as Lin Qian returned to his room from the medicine refining hall, he was stalked and dragged to the martial arts field by Xu Yang.
Lin Qian followed Xu Yang helplessly, looking listless.
Xu Yang, on the other hand, was very interested and kept telling him that he had met a particularly good senior brother who taught him Tong-Arm Boxing, and he made great progress in Tong-Arm Boxing.
I brought Lin Qian to the martial arts arena today because I planned to ask this senior brother to teach Lin Qian how to use the arm-through boxing.
Xu Yang smiled and hugged Lin Qian's shoulders, feeling like he was sharing a blessing.
When Lin Qian learned about Xu Yang's intentions, he was a little dumbfounded, but he couldn't refuse Xu Yang's kindness.
He has a golden finger, and his current proficiency in Tongjiquan cannot be said to be the best in the sect. At least he can still occupy a place in the top ten.
But Xu Yang had made an appointment, and refusing now would only embarrass Xu Yang in front of others.
"When the time comes, let's act."
Lin Qian thought secretly.
He didn't want others to know the progress of his Tongjiquan training.
It was dinner time at this time, and there were not many people in the martial arts arena.
And standing next to the martial arts stage was a strong man in black, it was Tang Jie.
"Junior Brother Xu, is this your friend?"
Tang Jie looked at Lin Qian next to Xu Yang and asked.
"Senior Brother Tang, this is my friend and my eldest brother, Lin Qian."
Xu Yang introduced happily.
"Senior Brother Tang."
Lin Qian said hello.
Tang Jie asked straight to the point; "Junior brother Lin, do you need me to teach you the arm-through boxing?"
"Don't worry, how about you guide Xu Yang first, and I'll take a look first."
Lin Qian smiled.
"Okay, Junior Brother Xu, can we come to the stage to practice?"
Tang Jie turned to Xu Yang and said.
Hearing Tang Jie's voice, Xu Yang responded directly with action. He had already jumped onto the high platform, looking eager to try.
Then Tang Jie also jumped on the stage, and the two used arm fists to fight.
Tang Jie's through-arm boxing is very powerful, but not flexible enough, while Xu Yang's through-arm boxing can only be said to be methodical.
Lin Qian watched the two fighting each other. If Tang Jie hadn't held back, Xu Yang would have been defeated in a short time.
And Lin Qian noticed that Tang Jie looked at him from the corner of his eye from time to time, which made him a little strange.
Soon the two of them finished sparring. Xu Yang was breathing heavily and sweating on his forehead, but Tang Jie seemed calm and relaxed.
During the sparring process, Tang Jie kept his hands and strength at bay, mainly because he was worried that he would be too aggressive and scare Lin Qian from coming up.
